items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Alphonso Trent would come to Tulsa and I would just stand in front of his band... I did a special trip in Muskogee to talk with Trent before I came up here.

ctx.x: I never heard of them; I'm surprised I haven't.

Again, right at that time, T. Holder began to come to. He came on back, but of course, before then, what encouraged me to go for the band, Al Trent, Alphonso Trent would come to Tulsa and I would just stand in front of his band and he had a youngster in there, Lee Hilliard; he played trumpet and alto.
